description: Three-tier web application (web, api, cache, db). The testbed application of M07.

assumptions.note: bytes_per_request = mean TCP-payload bytes per served web request over 3 runs (testbed/measurements/summary.csv); volumes = bytes x requests_per_s x 2,592,000 s. Rescale by changing requests_per_s.

components.rationale: HTTP front end / page renderer (module spec 2 vCPU / 8 GB)
in-memory cache in front of db (module spec 2 vCPU / 8 GB)
